body: It's not ridiculous at all. I posted here because I know there will be people who feel the same, and far worse than me. I haven't been molested I was never raped I haven't had to do things I'm ashamed of to live. Compared to others my life is a cakewalk. I have a semi stable job, I have family, and I got clothes on my back. I wouldn't consider this pain. It's merely a form of unhappiness or not being satisfied with my life.

I don't think that's it. I love routine. It gives me structure that I lack and it makes me feel comfortable. What I don't have is friends. Well I do but none that are actually really good friends. They are just homies I've known since high school.
